prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural or sculptural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection Fanggu. Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER ONLY, an existing Vairocana contour drawing. Match its elegant delicate slightly organic thin black lines, restrained detail, and generous blank areas. Do not copy the Buddha's subject geometry. Image 2 is a photograph of the ACTUAL NAMED MONUMENT and is the geometry reference. Preserve its identifying silhouette, visible structural counts, openings, proportions and current state. Make one refined sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF background. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the subject are pure white. Fine contours and a few selective internal structural lines; no grey shading, solid shadows, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, glow, checkerboard or transparency. Show the specified complete subject or explicitly stated local span, centered with breathing room, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Remove people, trees, vehicles, wires, signs, neighboring distractions and sky. No invented features, no labels, letters, calligraphy, caption, watermark, frame or border. Subject specifics: Landscape 1536x1024. Draw Hua'an Eryi Lou as seen from the front: broad low CYLINDRICAL round rammed-earth tulou whose curved outer wall forms a wide horizontal arc, single centered entry, rows of small square windows and narrow slit openings near top, dark projecting circular eaves. Retain round geometry and double-ring implication without inventing a square plan. Complete outer wall and roof uncut.
